'''Choren 9 (September 9)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|999}} - The menagerie crosses the river into [[Samara]]. [[Nynaeve]] meets [[Uno]], [[Galad]] and [[Masema]] and makes arrangements for a boat.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Rand]] assembles his forces outside [[Cairhien]]. [[Egwene]] and [[Aviendha]] agree to aid in the coming battle.
